tasks.spec:
You are a code worker. Your current working directory IS a git worktree of /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge. Edit files here directly. Do NOT git commit, push, or touch .git. You own exactly: frontend/e2e/blind-player.js, frontend/e2e/blind-player.test.js, frontend/e2e/blind-player.spec.js. Do NOT edit any existing file; import from them. Your tests must be hermetic node:test tests with injected fakes: they NEVER call the live game, OpenAI or any network. You must NOT run blind-player.spec.js (no staging URL or API key is available to you, and running it spends a billed budget).

GOAL: "L2 @blind-player" and "L3" from .plans/scene-affordance-e2e.md (read sections 4-L2, 4-L3, 5, 8, 9 and 10 first). A model plays one scene of the hosted game seeing ONLY what the real UI shows the player (the narration transcript, speech and action lines, and the status line "Scene <id> • <phase>"; no objective, no plot, no map), writing one command per turn. The test records whether the scene's transition fired and when, when each affordance was first shown, stuck turns, and silent transitions. It is noisy by nature, so it REPORTS rates over replicates and never fails on a play outcome; it fails only when the harness itself is broken.

READ FIRST (read-only): AGENTS.md "Writing Player Input" (every command the model writes must follow it: imperative; verb plus direct object; own things in first person possessive such as "my laptop"; no "I ..." sentences; no "do not/without/avoid" clauses; no non-events like Wait, Listen with nothing there, Keep watch); frontend/e2e/affordances.js, affordances.test.js, affordances.spec.js and scene-walk.js, scene-walk.test.js (built just before you: reuse mentions, firstStepAffordances, laterAffordances, measureScene, loadAffordanceMap and walkScenes; read their exports before using them); frontend/e2e/roleplay-judge.js (OpenAI Responses API call pattern with structured output, store:false, model from env default gpt-5.6-luna) and roleplay-judge.test.js; frontend/e2e/helpers.js; frontend/e2e/package-clock.js (loadPackagePacing and scenePoint(sceneId,"handoff") give the scene turn ceiling); bench/affordance_map.py (map shape: scenes[].location, entry_material with labels incl. bridge text, gates[].sources[] with id, kind, player_earned, reveals, and for engine sources their realization texts; transitions[] with target_scene_id).

BUILD frontend/e2e/blind-player.js (pure ESM, injectable, no top-level side effects), exporting:
- playerPrompt({transcript, status}): builds the model input. System text states the role (you are a player at a text adventure; you only know what you have read), the player-input rules above in plain words, and "reply with one command". It must contain NOTHING from the story package: no entity ids, no map, no plot, no scene objectives. The transcript is passed as data, the user message is the transcript plus the status line.
- askPlayer({transcript, status, environment, fetchImpl}): OpenAI Responses API with a JSON schema {command: string}, store:false, model = environment.E2E_PLAYER_MODEL || "gpt-5.6-luna", throws without OPENAI_API_KEY. Count calls in a returned/closed-over counter object and throw once the cap (default 20, from a parameter) is reached (billed-endpoint guard).
- validateCommand(command): returns {ok, problems[]} against the player-input rules (first person "I ", restraint words, non-events like "wait", must end with a period, 2 to 25 words). askPlayer retries ONCE with the problems appended to the user message, then throws.
- analyseRun({sceneEntry, nextSceneEntry, turns, firstStep, later, sceneMapSources}): turns is [{turn, input, text, state:{scene_id,turns_since_scene_entry,fired_storylet_ids,fired_pacing_event_ids}, grounding_ids, delivery:{must_convey_misses}}]. Returns {transition_fired, transition_turn, affordances:[{entity_id, first_shown_turn}], stuck_turns, stuck_runs (runs of 3+ consecutive stuck turns, each with the turns' inputs and text), silent_transition, l3:{...}}. Definitions: a STUCK turn is one whose command mentions (use mentions) no first-step or later affordance term of the gate AND whose response added no new fired_storylet_id and no new grounding_id. SILENT TRANSITION: the transition fired and at least one player-earned affordance of the gate was never shown (first_shown_turn null) in any text before or on the transition turn. L3 (report only): per turn that added a fired storylet or grounding id, the turn's delivery.must_convey_misses must be empty (list the misses); per fired pacing event that has engine realization text in the map, the turn text shares at least half of the content words (letters only, 4+ letters) of at least one realization (record matched or not, and the turn); on the transition turn, the final segment equals the next scene's entry text (normalised) and the earlier segments of that turn do not contain it, and the old scene's earlier turns never contain the next entry text (no skip, no restart).
- aggregate(runs): rates over replicates: transition rate and mean turn, per-affordance shown-by-deadline rate, stuck-run count, silent-transition rate. 
- formatMarkdown(report).

BUILD frontend/e2e/blind-player.spec.js with one test "a player who only reads the screen can leave the scene @blind-player": skipped unless E2E_API_BASE_URL and OPENAI_API_KEY are set; fails with a clear message unless GET <E2E_API_BASE_URL>/api/v1/version reports channel exactly "staging" (never production); reads E2E_BLIND_SCENE (default "1A") and E2E_BLIND_REPLICATES (default 1, max 3, refuse more); loads the map with loadAffordanceMap for the package folder whose story_id is continuity_initiative (find it as the affordances spec does); each replicate starts a fresh session, uses walkScenes to reach the chosen scene if it is not 1A (canon-journey prompts only to travel; the blind model takes over at the scene's entry), then loops: transcript = exactly the text the player has read so far (what the DOM transcript holds), status = the status line text, command = askPlayer(...), submitTurn(page, command), resolveWarningIfPresent, until state.scene_id changes or the turn count reaches min(20, handoff_after_turns + 2 from loadPackagePacing); writes writeCategoryReport("blind-player", {scene, replicates:[analyseRun...], aggregate}) which creates artifacts/e2e-blind-player.{json,md} and includes each full transcript and the commands written. Use E2E_TURN_TIMEOUT_MS semantics already in helpers.js (tell the user in notes to run with 90000). Set test.setTimeout(20 * 60_000). Do not use the package clock. The model call cap is 20 per replicate.

BUILD frontend/e2e/blind-player.test.js (node:test, hermetic): playerPrompt contains no package terms (pass it a fake map and assert none of its entity names or ids appear); askPlayer with a fake fetch (success, missing key, cap reached, invalid command then fixed on retry, invalid twice -> throws); validateCommand cases from the rules; analyseRun on hand-built turns for stuck turns, a stuck run of 3, a silent transition, a clean transition, L3 misses and the no-skip/no-restart check; aggregate over two runs.

HOW TO RUN (worktree root): cd frontend && node --test e2e/*.test.js. If frontend/node_modules is missing: ln -s /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge/frontend/node_modules frontend/node_modules (never npm install). The check also requires `playwright test --list --grep @blind-player` to list the test, a staging-channel guard string in the spec, OPENAI_API_KEY handling, and that blind-player.js builds its prompt without any map/plot terms.

OUTPUT: also write ./notes.md at the worktree root (not git-added): files read, judgment calls, the exact system prompt text, and the exact cap and guard behaviour.
